hardware: Apple M4 Max, 40 GPU cores, 48 GiB UMA
settings: 36 resident layers, 4 streamed for Atomic Engine. Stock Splash 1.6.1 weights/layout and auto verify rows. Both use the same 4000 token IDs and 64 greedy outputs, seed 42, short 15/8 warmup, fresh process per mode, zero prompt cache. Atomic Engine uses the BF16 draft. Splash uses its own native DFlash2 representation. Output text in each timed run was compared with the corresponding uninstrumented engine. Their continuations differ. All runs are sequential.

boundaries.atomic-engine: Wall time from generation target llama_process through existing llama_synchronize. Excludes drafter, accept and draft state update. Four streamed MoE callback intervals are timestamped from entry to return and removed as a union from every outside statistic. Outside still includes router, shared experts and scheduler work for these layers.
boundaries.splash: Plain generation is one Metal command. The diagnostic separates draft, target forward and accept/commit into three commands. Window spans submitCommandAsync(verify) and the wait on its ticket. It includes host prepare/submit. Splash has no streamed callback at 24 GiB. CPU waiting applies to this diagnostic submission, not to the event loop of the fused production cycle.

method.control: Trace GPUStartTime and GPUEndTime of command buffers, bracket actual Metal waits and Atomic Engine routed-reader waits in callbacks. All times are monotonic. Intersect intervals, clip them to each cycle, and take unions; overlapping waits are counted once. A live command buffer can contain internal dependencies, so occupancy is not per-shader utilization. No-stage control is the source for wall time and waiting. out_no_cb_other is wall outside active buffers and traced waits; it includes host work and unattributed time.
method.family: Both graphs tagged at the architecture boundaries of each of 30 GDN mixers, 10 full-attention mixers, 40 FFNs, vocabulary head, and other operations. Input norm, projections and residual are grouped with their relevant mixer. Capture, embedding and untagged bookkeeping go to other. Whole streamed callbacks excluded in Atomic Engine. Hardware MTL timestamp counter at start/end of each contiguous same-family compute pass. stage times can leave gaps inside command buffers.
method.sparse: Four uncached repeats. Each verify step samples one of four disjoint groups of layers ((layer/4) mod 4) rotating at a fixed step across requests. Summing four repetitions covers each layer once at each step. For per-step estimates, multiply mean measured layer time by 4. Head and untagged operations are timed each time and not multiplied. Additional family splits alter concurrency and pass costs.
method.attn: Separate low-overhead run timing native attention pipelines only using Metal compute pass start/end hardware counters. Pipeline names and invocation counts retained. Main and reduction compared separately. Splash additionally implements store, QKV preparation and gate as separate pipelines.
method.counter_clock: 4096 timestamp slots in shared Metal counter buffer (32 KiB diagnostic allocation outside engine ledger). Per-step paired CPU/GPU timestamps; convert GPU counter tick positions to the monotonic host axis, checked against command-buffer intervals. No spans with invalid timestamps used.
method.replicates: 2 requests per engine and mode, 4 in sparse. Per-step means weight each verify call equally. Control and marked passes are independent measurements; their times are not an additive breakdown of the uninstrumented wall.

family.1: MoE FFN including shared expert, router, normalization, residual

sparse.8: GDN recurrence or Splash fused verify GDN
sparse.11: shared/routed expert linears, Splash fused expert kernels
sparse.15: GDN unary, GLU and arithmetic (Atomic Engine)

raw_records.format: One JSON line per request. Records within each cycle: R sequence wall_begin_ns wall_end_ns cpu_cal_begin gpu_cal_begin cpu_cal_end gpu_cal_end host_mach_tick_to_ns; B command_begin_ns command_end_ns status; W Metal wait, I reader wait, L streamed callback begin/end (ns); T category gpu_timestamp_begin/end; K category pipeline invocation count; E end. On this device calibrated CPU/GPU timestamp pairs are already in ns. Per-step metrics are milliseconds, except counts. whole includes the callback, out excludes it.
